target_scope: V01官方商品图可见视角平面转译
exact_prompt: Use the attached official product photograph as the sole identity, outfit, proportions and pose reference. Translate the exact single small front-facing girl figure standing on the low red cylindrical base into a clean flat 2D full-body illustration on a pure white square canvas. Remove the dark backdrop, rocks, floor and photographic lighting. Preserve the very large pale peach rounded forehead and cheeks, pale dusty-pink center-parted hair with a short wide straight central fringe, two rounded coiled buns high on each side and two smooth narrow side locks reaching the jaw, and the small glossy dark-red cone cap centered between the buns with its visible dark round opening represented as a flat dark circle. Preserve the two large turquoise oval eyes with pale white outer crescents and tiny darker star-like internal details, subtle pink cheek areas and the small red slash mark high on the viewer-left forehead. Keep the black respirator-style face mask covering the nose and mouth, the two round black side filters and tiny pale-yellow bear-face emblem at the mask center. Do not invent a visible mouth under the mask. Preserve the cream puff sleeves, pale white bodice, two dark-red boxing gloves held up in front of the chest with narrow white wrist bands, short flared pearly gray-blue ruffle skirt with a scalloped wavy hem, short chubby bare legs with a small red scratch on the viewer-right knee, one lavender ankle shoe on the viewer-left foot and the other bare foot on viewer-right. Keep the exact offset leg stance and glove positions. Preserve the large-head, tiny-body ratios and the low broad red base, but leave its side panels blank without lettering or brand marks. Use thin clean dark outlines and flat solid local colors; simplify the translucent skirt into a few light gray-blue panels without real reflections, plastic gloss, dimensional shading, texture or cast shadows. Do not add lashes, a smile, new weapons, extra props, long hair, a second shoe or scenery. No text, no logos beyond the tiny non-letter bear-face motif specified above, no watermark. Reconstruct only this visible view and do not invent rear or side details.
observations: 粉双丸发、短中央刘海、红尖帽、大额头蓝眼、黑面罩熊徽、红拳套、皱裙、一紫鞋一裸脚与红底的关系接近。眼内星与熊徽强化，尖帽/底座比例略改、保留少量浅明暗；按测试要求去掉底座文字。只证明当前遮挡视角的附图平面转译，不证明遮住的口鼻或纯文字复现。
revision_reason: 首轮明确绑定已实际看过的本地官方原图
validation: 逐项目视对照，无数值相似度、多用户盲测或重复稳定性结论
